messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Is Article 50(1) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, which sets out the rules on penalties, already applicable as of 1 September 2026?

response.text: L'articolo 50, paragrafo 1, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, che stabilisce le norme in materia di sanzioni, è già applicabile a partire dal 1° settembre 2026?
